environment.description: Same Node.js 18 migration service on ECS Fargate. The ALB listener on port 443 is configured with mutual TLS (mTLS) passthrough mode using a trust store referencing an internal PKI CA bundle (arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate-authority/abc-def-123). The ALB's mTLS configuration has 'verify' mode enabled with revocation checking via OCSP stapling. Only client certificates issued by the internal CA with OU=platform-migrations are present in the trust store. The target group health check path is /healthz which bypasses mTLS (health check uses the ALB's own connection). Additionally, the ECS task role has an IAM condition restricting the service to only accept connections forwarded by the ALB (via aws:SourceArn condition on the task's security group ingress rules allowing only the ALB security group). The Node.js process binds to 0.0.0.0:3000 but the security group only allows inbound from the ALB's security group on port 3000.

config.load_balancer: ALB with mTLS verify mode, trust store: arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:truststore/internal-pki-ca/ts-abc123
config.trust_store_ca: Internal ACM-PCA CA, only issues certs to OU=platform-migrations team members
config.revocation: OCSP stapling enabled, CRL distribution point checked
config.network: Private subnet, ECS task SG ingress only from ALB SG on port 3000
config.note: mTLS passthrough headers (X-Amzn-Mtls-Clientcert-Serial-Number, X-Amzn-Mtls-Clientcert-Subject) are logged but not used for application-level authorization
